WITH longest_waiters AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.org_spec,
        c.clin_recip_registry as patient_id,
        REPLACE(c.wait_time, ' days', '')::int as wait_days,
        ri.pra_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tm.org_spec ORDER BY REPLACE(c.wait_time, ' days', '')::int DESC) as rn
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN clinical c ON tm.recip_ref_reg = c.clin_recip_registry
    JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON tm.recip_ref_reg = ri.immu_recip_registry
),
comorbidity_count AS (
    SELECT 
        mh.contrib_med_registry,
        LENGTH(mh.med_history) - LENGTH(REPLACE(mh.med_history, ',', '')) + 1 
            - CASE WHEN mh.med_history = 'None' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END as raw_count,
        CASE 
            WHEN mh.med_history = 'None' THEN 0
            ELSE LENGTH(mh.med_history) - LENGTH(REPLACE(mh.med_history, ',', '')) + 1
        END as comorbidity_tally
    FROM medical_history mh
)
SELECT 
    lw.org_spec,
    lw.patient_id,
    lw.wait_days,
    lw.pra_score,
    cc.comorbidity_tally
FROM longest_waiters lw
LEFT JOIN comorbidity_count cc ON 1=1
WHERE lw.rn = 1
ORDER BY lw.org_spec, lw.wait_days DESC
